policies.title: No fakematches
policies.text: A function counts only when natural source compiles to the original bytes. Register pins, ordering tricks and asm stand-ins stay NonMatching with a FIXME saying what differs; the few crack-pass exceptions are tagged and listed in docs/CRACK_PASS.md.

policies.title: Adversarial review of every submission
policies.text: A separate reviewer that never saw the author's reasoning judges names, types and readability (ACCEPT / CHANGES / REJECT); the gate checks the rest mechanically. Only ACCEPT merges.

policies.title: Honest report plus SHA-1
policies.text: Every unit is diffed with relocations checked, and every merge links main.dol and checks its SHA-1. Byte-pattern hits and lenient diffs never count; partial credit appears only in the separately labelled weighted figure.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.summary: Measurement that does not trust the work, the file maps, the compiler setup and the shared game headers everything else builds on.

milestones.title: The honest objdiff report
milestones.desc: Every unit diffed with relocations checked; report.json is never quoted.

milestones.title: main.dol links byte-identically
milestones.desc: A plain ninja links every Matching unit and ends in the SHA-1 check.

milestones.title: Gate, review and merge queue
milestones.desc: tools/gate.py, the adversarial review and coord.py's serial merges.

milestones.title: Library map and game file map
milestones.desc: lib_map.tsv places every library file; tu_map.tsv found the game's files from .ctors, extab and float pools, now 528 game units in splits.txt with their data ranges.

measure.label: of the code split into units

milestones.title: Game compiler setup
milestones.desc: GC/2.6 -O4,p, -inline auto,deferred, C++ exceptions, stmw on, fp_contract on, read-only strings; proven on the first game functions and THP.

milestones.title: Deferred inlining for game code
milestones.desc: Game code builds with -inline auto,deferred, as the original did (vtables before jump tables in .data, later-defined functions inlined). Every game source lists its functions in descending address order; callees the original never inlines get an evidenced auto_inline region (docs/INLINING.md).

milestones.title: Shared game headers, one owner each
milestones.desc: ActorBase, ActorManager, Player, GameView, Effect, Map and collision, Camera, GameState, EnemyBase and SpriteAnim, Message, BgRewrite, GameMath, and one header per actor in include/game/act/.

milestones.title: Generated code
milestones.desc: tools/gen_game.py writes the 9-pool audio __sinit, simple actor destructors and the player forwarders in tu_8022AD64 from reviewed templates (about 440 units), each checked by gen_game.py --check in the gate.

milestones.title: This progress website
milestones.desc: Regenerated from the honest report in every merge commit.

phases.title: Libraries
phases.summary: Donor-first imports from mkdd, oot-gc and pikmin2, then file by file. Everything is in; about fifty functions are left.

milestones.title: Dolphin SDK and GX
milestones.desc: Every SDK and GX function matches and links, GBA and the SDK leftovers included.

milestones.title: JSystem
milestones.desc: JKernel, JUtility, JAudio, JParticle, J2DGraph, J3D, JMessage and the rest, imported and ground file by file at -O4,p.

milestones.title: MSL, Runtime and MetroTRK
milestones.desc: The Metrowerks C library, the C++ runtime and the debugger stub from pikmin2.

milestones.title: Library holdouts
milestones.desc: About fifty JSystem functions that resist (register allocation and J3DMatBlock's word copies, kept honest with FIXMEs) and MSL's ansi_fp and strtoul. Most go to the crack pass.

phases.title: Game code: the method
phases.summary: How the game code gets written. Small functions first in waves, then big functions structure first, in boot-path order, with tools that find donor code and measure partial progress.

milestones.title: Waves of small-function units
milestones.desc: One agent per file, one reviewer per wave. Actor waves, the ActorManager spawner (tu_801F9484, 322 functions) and many small units are merged; recurring shapes are in the rules card.

milestones.title: Haiku grind
milestones.desc: tools/grind.py on branch grind added about 650 small game functions, script-judged; an Opus review fixed about 200 and dropped 12 before the port to matching.

milestones.title: Boot-path ordering
milestones.desc: Dolphin execution coverage from power-on to a live Shadow Battle ranks the game files the game runs first (docs/BOOT_PATH.md). It sets the order of the work and the first two game parts on this site.

milestones.title: Structural and weighted measures
milestones.desc: tools/structural.py counts functions that differ only in registers or order, and the weighted figure gives them partial credit. Both are shown apart from the honest numbers.

milestones.title: Donor-lead preflight
milestones.desc: tools/donor_leads.py fingerprints a unit and finds allowed donor code that resembles it before work starts.

milestones.title: Big functions, structure first
milestones.desc: Write a big function before it reaches 100 %, merge it when it is structurally done or close, so the literal pool, field offsets and callee names settle (docs/RULES_CARD.md). Just started on the file select, game mode screen and GBA link units.

phases.title: Game code: part by part
phases.summary: The 3.4 MiB of FSA's own code, in the order the game runs it. The boot path first, then the actors and everything else.

milestones.title: Boot to main menu
milestones.desc: main(), the framework, the THP movie player (162 of 168 functions), the title screen and the screens built at boot (file select, the game mode screen, the GBA link manager).

milestones.title: Main menu to Shadow Battle
milestones.desc: Stage load, the players, the field and the actors on it, up to two Links fighting on The Field.

milestones.title: Screens and menus
milestones.desc: The remaining screens, HUD and menus, after their boot-path owners are written.

milestones.title: Actors by family
milestones.desc: Enemies, NPCs and objects family by family, sharing base classes and headers. The earlier actor waves matched the small ones; most update and init functions are still ahead.

milestones.title: The player
milestones.desc: The Link class and the per-player queries, after the boot path has fixed its layout.

milestones.title: Map and stage
milestones.desc: Rooms, collision, background rewrites and the stage loader.

milestones.title: Everything else
milestones.desc: Systems, minigames and the files no one has identified yet.

phases.title: Crack pass, names and the finish
phases.summary: The resistant remainder with stronger models, evidence-based names, and the whole DOL built from source.

milestones.title: Crack pass
milestones.desc: Resistant functions with a stronger model and the permuter. A trick is allowed only for a hard blocker, tagged FAKEMATCH(crack-pass) and listed in docs/CRACK_PASS.md.

milestones.title: Open questions
milestones.desc: Literals pooled before their first use, the save-data layout and the units out of address order (docs/CRACK_PASS.md, Open questions). Inlining of later-defined functions and the vtable / jump-table order were answered by deferred inlining (docs/INLINING.md).

milestones.title: Actor table
milestones.desc: English names for all 402 actor IDs, each citing in-game text, the wiki or stages.

milestones.title: The naming track
milestones.desc: Real names for game files, classes and functions, from debug and assert strings, Dolphin debug output and the dormant debug menus, reviewed on their own.

milestones.title: Every unit Matching
milestones.desc: All of main.dol built from source with the original SHA-1; a portable build becomes possible.
